sam: Kicking off slice-and-hold cutover for r1.2.3. Change window 02:00-03:00 UTC. Plan: shadow (10m) -> 10% -> 30% -> 70% -> 100% with 4m waits. Gate checks: p95 < 1.5x baseline, 5xx < 0.8%, redis miss delta < 10%. Rollback if breach persists >120s.
leah: green pool is up (8 gpus), image verified, healthchecks passing. router rule created as lane-slice-v2.
rui: deploy-bot: starting shadow phase now. warming probes running; warm cache expected ~2m. dashboard: http://grafana/release/r1.2.3
mina: monitoring 5xx and queue depth. if we see queue > 500 or 5xx > 0.8% I'll request a "pause" here.
deploy-bot: shadow complete. no errors. moving to 10% in 2m.
sam: quick pin/rollback snippets in case we need to force blue back — paste outputs.
```
curl -X POST 'https://router-api.internal/pin' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ROUTER_TOKEN' -d '{"version":"blue","reason":"rollback r1.2.3 - urgent"}'
```
Alternative (infra host): `./infra route pin --to blue --force`
leah: 10% stable after 3m. p95 360ms (baseline 320), 5xx 0.12%. proceeding to 30%.
rui: traffic update: green=30% at 1768456890. watch: p95 and redis miss rate.
mina: small spike in redis misses to ~8% while ramping, but latency steady. holding 1m to observe.
sam: noted. if redis miss > 12% or p95 > 2x baseline, we roll back.
leah: moving to 70% now. using graceful drain window of 30s for prior backends.
deploy-bot: green=70% at 1768456980. p95 410ms, 5xx 0.09%, redis miss 6.5%. all within gates.
mina: queue depth briefly rose to 420 but recovered. no action.
sam: final 4m hold then full shift. reminder: post-deploy tasks: update routing policy docs, add one-line release note, tag infra flags.
rui: green=100% at 1768457070. rollout complete. tagging r1.2.3-deployed.
sam: release note to append: "Blue/Green lane-slice cutover r1.2.3 — gradual slice-and-hold rollout; metrics within thresholds; rollback runbook recorded in ops repo." closing thread. thanks everyone :sparkles:
